target: scripts/qa_gate.py — add a required falsifiable_check field (command + fails_when) to the QA report schema for critical/standard tiers, with a self-comparison heuristic.
findings_summary: No DB access involved: qa_gate.py reads a JSON file and runs git/AST checks only — verified by reading its imports and _connect-free structure. Verified before writing: (1) TIER_REQUIREMENTS is a per-tier dict at scripts/qa_gate.py:30-52 with the shape assumed; (2) qa_gate.py IS wired into .githooks/pre-push:108, so the new field is enforced on every push and cannot be forgotten; (3) PreToolUse hooks can block on Write content — .claude/hooks/prior-art-guard.py reads tool_input.content/new_string and sys.exit(2)s, confirming the pattern for the follow-up status-linter. Deliberately NOT required at minor tier: a gate that fires on trivial changes gets dismissed by muscle memory (DQ-34 alarm-fatigue lesson). Existing reports lacking the field will now fail at critical/standard — intended, that is the friction. Rollout risk: any in-flight branch must add the field before pushing.
